title: Oversized Parcel
description: A shady customs document upload arrives as an oversized PDF, right at and just past the 5MB ceiling. Pin down the exact boundary the server enforces, rather than trusting a round number from memory.
successCondition: Book a shipment. POST /api/booking/:id/documents with a file exactly 5*1024*1024 bytes (5,242,880 bytes) and a valid application/pdf mimetype returns 201. The same upload with a file at 5,242,881 bytes (one byte over) returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR mentioning the size limit, and GET /api/booking/:id/documents confirms only the first upload was persisted.
hints: MAX_DOCUMENT_SIZE_BYTES is exactly 5 * 1024 * 1024 — construct your test files to that exact byte count and one over, not an approximation like "5MB-ish".

The multipart file-size limit is enforced by the upload middleware itself (Fastify's fileSize option), which is what produces the FST_REQ_FILE_TOO_LARGE path — mind that your test client actually streams the full oversized body rather than truncating it client-side.
